summary: HarbourVest Private Equity Secondaries Fund L.P., a Delaware private fund, filed an 8-K on September 8, 2026 covering an unregistered continuous private placement. On August 3, 2026, later finalized September 3, 2026, it sold 250,017 Class I limited partnership units for roughly $2.98 million, priced off July 31, 2026 transactional NAV of $11.92 per Class I unit; the wider HSEC Fund Complex issued about $4.9 million. Sales went to accredited investors and qualified purchasers under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or regulatory clock is stated. Watch only if future filings disclose a tender, secondary, or liquidity event tied to these NAV marks.
